rules.statement: The Civil Procedure Code aims to prevent the frustration of civil proceedings due to irregularities that have not caused prejudice.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The object of the Civil Procedure Code is to prevent civil proceedings from being frustrated by any kind of irregularity or lapse which has not caused prejudice or harm to a party.
